title: NASC-seq Protocol for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing
author: Gert-Jan Hendriks
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.whtfb6n

steps.title: Label Cells with 4sU
steps.instruction: Grow cells in the presence of 50 μM 4sU, minimizing direct light exposure. Collect untreated cells as a control if necessary.

substeps.instruction: Stop labeling by transferring cells to 15-ml falcon tubes on ice.
Wash cells with cold PBS (4 °C).

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer and Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare lysis buffer and keep on ice (4 °C).

substeps.instruction: Distribute 3 μl of freshly prepared lysis buffer to each well of a 96-well PCR plate using a multichannel or high-throughput liquid dispensing system.
Keep the lysis plate on ice (4 °C).

steps.title: Distribute Single Cells
steps.instruction: Distribute single cells into each well of the lysis plate via FACS sorting.

substeps.instruction: Keep cells and lysis plate cooled (4 °C) before, during, and after sorting.
Seal plates with aluminum foil and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Oligo-dT Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare the Dynabeads by vortexing well before pipetting to ensure they are not sedimented. Do not use DNA-low-bind consumables.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 60 μl Dynabeads to a clean eppendorf tube.
Place beads on a magnet, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 60 μl Dynabeads buffer A.
Place beads on a magnet, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 60 μl Dynabeads buffer B.
Place beads on a magnet, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 60 μl Dynabeads 2x binding and washing buffer and 60 μl of oligo-dT (100 μM).
Incubate beads with oligo-dT at room temperature with agitation for 15 minutes.
Place beads on a magnet, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 60 μl Dynabeads 1x binding and washing buffer.
Resuspend the beads in 220 μl of freshly prepared bead resuspension buffer and keep on ice (4 °C).

steps.title: Lyse Cells and Denature RNA
steps.instruction: Remove the lysis plate from -80 °C and thaw on ice (4 °C). If proceeding immediately from FACS, freeze cells at -80 °C for 5 minutes first.

substeps.instruction: Place the lysis plate in a thermocycler and denature RNA at 80 °C for 3 minutes.
Cool the plate to 4 °C after denaturing.

steps.title: Bind mRNA to Beads
steps.instruction: Distribute 2 μl of oligo-dT beads to each well of the lysis plate.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the beads for 20 minutes at room temperature (20 °C) with agitation.

steps.title: Stop mRNA Binding
steps.instruction: Spin the plate down gently and place on a magnet.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10 μl of STOP mix into each well while the plate is on the magnet.
Spin the plate down gently, place back on the magnet, and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature (20 °C).

steps.title: Perform Alkylation
steps.instruction: Prepare the alkylation mix at room temperature (20 °C) using single-use aliquots of iodoacetamide dissolved in DMSO at 200 mM (handle in a fume hood).

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μl of the alkylation mix to each well, spin gently, and incubate with agitation at 50 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription (RT)
steps.instruction: Prepare the Reverse Transcription mix and STOP mix (STOP mix: 460 μl Superscript II RT buffer, 586.50 μl Nuclease-free water, 34.50 μl Tween 20 (10%), 9.00 μl DTT (1M), Total 1011.50 μl; keep on ice).

substeps.instruction: Remove supernatant from each well carefully while the plate is on the magnet, avoiding the beads.
Immediately add 10 μl of Reverse Transcription mix to the side of the well to avoid drying the beads.
Perform RT program: 42 °C for 1.5 hours; then 10 cycles of (50 °C for 2 min, 42 °C for 2 min); hold at 4 °C.
Vortex the plate every 20 minutes during the RT program to prevent bead settling.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA via PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR mix and add 12 μl of the PCR mix to each well containing reverse transcribed cDNA.

substeps.instruction: Perform PCR program: 98 °C for 3 min; 22 cycles of (98 °C for 20 sec, 67 °C for 15 sec, 72 °C for 6 min); final extension 72 °C for 5 min; hold at 4 °C.
Optional: Store unpurified amplified cDNA library at -20 °C for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Purify cDNA Libraries
steps.instruction: Add 18 μl AMPure XP beads to each well of amplified cDNA libraries, mix by pipetting, and incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Move plate to magnet, wait 5 minutes, remove supernatant, and wash beads with 50 μl 80% ethanol.
Remove supernatant and dry beads for 5 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 17 μl nuclease-free water and incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes.
Move plate to magnet, immobilize beads for 5 minutes, and transfer 16 μl of supernatant to a new plate.

steps.title: Quantify and Dilute cDNA
steps.instruction: Analyze 1 μl of each well of the cDNA library plate using QuantiFluor assay.

substeps.instruction: Dilute cDNA from all libraries to 200 pg/μl based on measured concentrations.

steps.title: Tagmentation
steps.instruction: Prepare the tagmentation mix and distribute 3 μl of Tagmentation mix to each well of a new 96-well plate; keep on ice (4 °C).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 1 μl of each diluted cDNA library (200 pg/μl) into the tagmentation mix plate and incubate at 55 °C for 5 minutes.
Stop the reaction by adding 1 μl of NT buffer to each well and incubating for 5 minutes at room temperature (20 °C).

steps.title: Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Add 2 μl of premixed Illumina N7/N5 compatible indexing primers (1 μM) to each well.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 μl of Illumina PCR mix (NPM) to each well.
Perform PCR: 72 °C for 3 min, 95 °C for 30 sec; 10 cycles of (95 °C for 10 sec, 55 °C for 30 sec, 72 °C for 30 sec); final extension 72 °C for 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Pool and Final Purification
steps.instruction: Pool 2.5 μl from each well into a 1.5 ml eppendorf tube, then transfer 200 μl of the mixed pool to another new eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Place on magnet for 5 minutes and transfer the supernatant (300 μl pooled library + PEG) to a new 1.5 ml tube.
Add 60 μl AMPure XP beads, mix, and bind for 15 minutes.
Place on magnet for 5 minutes, remove supernatant, and wash with 200 μl 80% ethanol (repeat wash 4 times for total of 5 washes).
Dry beads for 5 minutes.
Add 100 μl AMPure XP beads and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature to exclude large fragments.
Resuspend beads in 60 μl nuclease-free water and allow 5 minutes to release DNA.
Transfer 55 μl of the final resuspended NASC-seq library to a new 1.5 ml tube and store on ice (4 °C).

steps.title: Quality Control and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Measure the final library concentration using the Qubit DNA HS kit and prepare a 4 nM final library for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Analyze 1 μl of the final NASC-seq library on the Agilent Bioanalyzer using a DNA high sensitivity chip.
Sequence on an Illumina NextSeq or NovaSeq using standard primers (recommended paired-end 2x 150 cycles).
